page.title: About
page.p: SuperTuxKart is an enhanced version of TuxKart, a kart racing game, originaly done by Steve Baker, featuring Tux and a bunch of his friends. SuperTuxKart is the work of the GotM run for TuxKart at happypenguin.org. Due to some disagreements that happened in that time this fork of TuxKart was done.

ul.li: some smaller graphical improvemnts (skidmarks, smoke, animated wheels, etc.)
